summary.text: Wind Thunder Roar is Hao Zhen and Chou Lao Wu's double immortal killer move. Chou Lao Wu forms a dark green wind ball and Hao Zhen a lightning plasma pool; their joint roar fuses both into a wind and lightning pillar.

claims.text: At Iron Eagle blessed land, Hao Zhen and Chou Lao Wu cast to save Immortal Wang from Green City Rampage. They spend red date immortal essence and call the double immortal killer move by name as the attack digs trenches across the grassland and hits the green giant’s chest in two breaths.

Fang Yuan judges that a direct hit would kill him for sure. Using the move leaves Hao Zhen pale and both of them in bad shape, so they retreat quickly. The green giant almost perfectly blocked the pillar, then stands still and breaks apart; Bai Zu tribe Gu Immortals spit blood and fall.

Chou Lao Wu cannot believe wind thunder roar alone could harm a formation that rivals rank eights; Fang Yuan realizes they were not familiar enough with the formation. This was Bai Zu tribe’s first true battle using Green City Rampage, so errors were understandable.

Inside Hei Fan grotto-heaven they use it again as their strongest technique against a hundred desolate beast wolves; the pillar leaves few standing, kills two true bodies among mostly clones, and onlookers call the battle strength the peak of rank seven. The cast has a huge price: afterward both have reduced battle strength for a period, so allies protect them as a tool against desolate beast groups.
Joint immortal killer moves between close Gu Immortals are compared to Traveling Three Elites, with wind thunder roar of Chou Lao Wu and Hao Zhen called similar.
Narration states that Hao Zhen and Chou Lao Wu’s wind thunder roar is renowned throughout Northern Plains and can pressure opponents, though both are already injured from separate battles.

Hao Zhen later says that in a two-on-two they could wipe foes with it, while knowing the move is not easy and needs a safe environment, as when other Gu Immortals protected them during Heavenly Lord Bai Zu’s attack on Hei Fan grotto-heaven.
